name: Arcane Quest Multiplayer Platform
description: Arcane Quest is a cross‑platform multiplayer game that blends real‑time strategy with immersive storytelling. The platform will support dynamic matchmaking, in‑game economies, and community-driven content creation. It aims to deliver a seamless, low‑latency experience for players worldwide.
objectives: Provide real‑time, low‑latency multiplayer gameplay across PC, console, and mobile.
Enable a robust in‑game economy with secure micro‑transactions and item trading.
Facilitate community content creation through mod support and user‑generated levels.
Ensure high availability and scalability to support millions of concurrent players.
Deliver comprehensive analytics for player engagement and monetization insights.
success_criteria: Latency remains below 50 ms for 95% of all matches.
Monthly active users exceed 2 million within six months of launch.
In‑game economy transactions process with 99.8% success rate.
System uptime is 99.95% over any 30‑day period.
Player retention rate at 30 days is above 60%.
